title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
ECB holds Sep 10 — rates at 2.00%, vs 99%-priced 25bp hike to 2.50%. EUR lower, DAX -1.74%, CAC -1.94%.
PPI Aug: core +2.8% YoY vs 3.5% exp — large disinflation undershoot; FOMC Sep 16 hike odds drift to ~57% (was 63%).
CPI Aug due tomorrow Sep 11 8:30am ET — next key FOMC catalyst ahead of Sep 16 decision.
